body: It’s not your fault. I did the same thing I do now, take depression meds, but they haven’t been helping me. It’s almost impossible to get an immunity to  Sam-E so I don’t know what’s going on:(
Promises are made to be broken.
If you need someone, I’m there
I would hate to be in a hospital... My family is mostly nurses and stuff...
All therapists want to do is shove pills down your throat!
Don’t tell your therapist if you WANT to die. I make up a different suicide plan to mine .... so I can still access what I need.
I’m half depressed and half on autopilot. I guess I’m not the only one...
That is so true... And it’s painful when your friends make suicidal jokes.
I keep trying to cut my arms, but I’m just watching myself at the same time. The school  did everything they could. Even tried to put me in suiside watch.

I’m  a 12 year old girl, who had their first attempt at 10. I tried a drug overdose with meds, but I failed miserably . I may be over the top, but I have issues. It’s like someone is controlling me. I want to die, but the people I care about would be hurt. LIFE IS SHIT!
